why: Partial-escape catcher: the artifact (5 elements, symbols, atomic numbers) is trivially memorizable, so ONLY the recorded navigation trace proves Floe's browser visited all 5 pages — trace_nav requires 5 distinct successful navigates. Verified 2026-08-02: all five article URLs return 200.
task: Navigate DIRECTLY with the navigate action, one page at a time, to the English Wikipedia article for each of these five chemical elements: Hydrogen, Helium, Lithium, Beryllium, Boron (URL pattern https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/<Element>). From EACH article's infobox record the element's chemical symbol and atomic number. Write elements.csv with columns name, symbol, atomic_number — exactly one row per element, in the order given. Do not answer from memory: every row must come from a page you actually opened.
